name: triplecrown-mobile
description: The TripleCrown app as a native shell for Android and iOS (Capacitor).

scripts.ios:sim: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 18 Pro' -derivedDataPath build/ios build | grep -E 'error:|BUILD (SUCCEEDED|FAILED)' ; xcrun simctl boot 'iPhone 18 Pro' 2>/dev/null; xcrun simctl install booted build/ios/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/App.app && xcrun simctl launch booted com.sengi.triplecrown && open -a Simulator
